physics: A high held probability alone is not enough to ignore a rich exit when the book already marks the held side below the executable bid. Negative-gap value exits are suppressed only when the fair-value drawdown is shallow, preserving temporary-mark recovery while avoiding deep adverse moves with generous exit liquidity.
rule: Suppress value-over-hold exits when p_hold - exit_bid >= 0.00, or when p_hold >= 0.85 and fair_drawdown_cents >= -5.0. Suppress probability_reduce exits only when p_hold >= 0.79 and p_hold - exit_bid >= 0.00. Keep collapse exits unchanged.
